shared_benchmark_traits.timing_scope: Separate source map/reduce configurations, mean per selected kernel launch over10 repeats
keyconfounds: The source implements simultaneous higher-score pairwise suppression using intersection divided by the higher-score square area, not intersection-over-union or a score-sorted greedy acceptance loop. A higher-score box can suppress another even if itself suppressed. These are operator boundaries, not an imposed alternative correctness target.

Source README identifies face-detector window postprocessing, but the provided image/sample detections are absent here. The named fixture is synthetic: 512 separated clusters of eight positive-width boxes, four dyadic score levels with ties, full MAX_DETECTIONS=4096. No detection precision/recall or trained-model accuracy claim.

Native AoS float4 versus existing Julia and portable SoA arrays is a real layout adaptation. Native reduction has 32 collective __syncthreads_and rounds/global-byte updates; existing Julia folds 32 partitions locally then uses one 128-lane shared AND tree. Algebraic equivalence is verified, but timing gaps cannot be assigned solely to frontend abstraction.

Original native reduction has all threads store the same global byte after each vote. This static concurrent-writer pattern is retained and disclosed; no sanitizer race witness or universal race-free guarantee is claimed. All named five-trial outputs match the independent full oracle. Native source is unchanged, not silently repaired.

All 16777216 pairwise UInt8 values and all 4096 keep flags are checked; 65536 actual Float32 input bytes are compared exactly separately. Inputs finite; strict threshold margin at least0.00864196 supports this fixture, not arbitrary near-threshold floating-point cases.

The two original timer regions remain separate configurations: ten map launches then completion, or ten reduction launches then completion. Other stage preparation/validation is outside the selected timer. Both stages execute for correctness in every trial; no stage is omitted from the port.

Buffer initialization/reset, input transfer, CPU oracle and serialization are outside timing. Blocking device-wide completion matches native cudaDeviceSynchronize, including warmup/pre/post timing. Five outer trials, mean last four, no outlier selection. Original Makefile1000 repetitions is named-study10, same full input extent.

Native and Julia map use 16×16 blocks and256×256 grid, reduce uses128 lanes and4096 blocks. KA/JACC preserve selected geometry and existing Julia local-fold/tree strategy. Backend bounds/index lowering and memory code generation may differ.

JACC uses explicit zero dynamic shared memory for map and128 bytes for reduction, stages a128-byte zero template and an extra barrier. CUDA.jl/KA use uninitialized static/local128-byte scratch overwritten before use. Register/spill/occupancy/cache effects remain unknown.

Map gap and JACC-versus-KA reduction gap are observed without profiles; template staging alone is not established as their cause. Nominal memory size or source operations do not establish measured roofline position or DRAM traffic. Comparisons, min/max, division and logical AND require an explicit operation convention.
All tested kernels use their own framework index/shared/barrier APIs; CUDA allocation/completion host glue is tested only on NVIDIA. No cross-vendor portability conclusion.

Existing CUDA.jl device bodies are byte-preserved; current work is adapter/entry guard plus full numerical verification. One host closure named map shadowed Base.map inside CUDA launch macro before device JIT, fixed by renaming; no device arithmetic repair.

KA/JACC each pass one candidate and two device-JIT process checks with two kernel definitions and no repairs. Source shape/two timing configurations/five trials are not extra compiler attempts. Internal passes and compiled specialization counts unknown.

Usage is split by an urgent, independently metered MLP measurement repair: initial NMS inspection windows closed, then resumed windows. No complete single-window NMS cost is claimed; retained nonoverlapping segments include cached context/coordination and overlapping workflow/child windows are not additive billing.

scientific_intent.scientific_task: Suppress lower-score overlapping square detection windows by a parallel all-pairs predicate and rowwise keep mask. Source README gives a face-detection use case; current study uses synthetic boxes.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: For score_i<score_j, pairkeep(i,j)=[intersection(i,j)/(width_j+1)^2 < Float32(.3)] AND [width_j!=0]; otherwise pairkeep=1. Keep(i)=AND_j pairkeep(i,j). Integer-pixel +1 convention, square widths, equal-score ties retained.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: 4096 square windows in512 spatial clusters of8; dense4096×4096 pair graph, rowwise logical reduction, no PDE discretization.
invariants: All pair/keep bytes are0 or1, all diagonal pairs remain1, equal scores do not suppress each other.
Every keep flag equals AND of its4096 pair bytes.
All40 saved artifacts byte-exact against actual input bytes and full independent Float64 predicate oracle;1024 windows kept.
accuracy_requirements: Full16777216 pair bytes plus4096 keep flags in every model/trial/configuration.
Exact65536-byte serialized Float32 input prefix, all input values finite.
Independent Float64 predicate uses exact promoted source Float32 threshold; minimum active threshold margin0.008641963, no tolerance applied to logical outputs.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Float32 overlap division controls a discrete threshold decision; large threshold margin in this fixture avoids rounding-boundary ambiguity. General near-threshold behavior is not certified.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: Full source maximum4096 detections, positive widths8/12/16, clustered overlap and tied scores; source text-input parsing, small/padded cases, zero/negative widths and real-image quality unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Computer-vision candidate-window postprocessing, source-documented face detection example; not a trained detector or accuracy evaluation.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: Source pairwise operator is not claimed equivalent to IoU/greedy alternatives. Layout/reduction adaptations and unprofiled implementation effects constrain performance attribution.
